verdict.rationale: Lago documents an AI Dunning Agent that acts as an AR analyst for overdue invoices. It reviews twelve months of invoices, payments, disputes and provider status before chasing, then hands the rest to a person. Cash-collection filters also surface overdue, partially paid or unpaid invoices. However, nothing shows automatic re-attempts of failed card or renewal payments on a scheduled or ML-optimized cadence, and nothing quantifies recovery. Missing for 10: documented automatic payment-retry logic for failed renewals, a configurable or ML-optimized retry schedule, measured recovery or involuntary-churn metrics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
